name: zoco-ai
description: Zoco AI — self-hosted voice calling platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix realtime
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,livekit,pipecat -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix realtime" "bash scripts/run-pipecat.sh"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.pm2:start: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix realtime && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix realtime && pm2 startOrReload ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env && pm2 save
scripts.pm2:restart: pm2 restart zoco-api zoco-web zoco-worker zoco-pipecat
scripts.pm2:stop: pm2 stop zoco-api zoco-web zoco-worker zoco-pipecat
scripts.pm2:logs: pm2 logs zoco-api zoco-web zoco-worker zoco-pipecat
